chapters.title: Spiral into Horror
content: The story begins in the small town of Kurouzu-cho, which means 'Black Vortex Town'.
The town is cursed with the obsessive and supernatural phenomenon of spirals.
Kirie Goshima, a high school girl, notices strange occurrences around town.
Her boyfriend, Shuichi Saito, is the first to become aware of the spiral curse.
Shuichi's father becomes obsessed with spirals and spends his days in his study.
He stares at patterns of spirals and becomes increasingly unstable.
The father's obsession with spirals grows into madness.
He collects objects with spiral patterns and refuses to eat or sleep.
Shuichi watches helplessly as his father's condition worsens.
Kirie is skeptical about the curse at first.
She believes the events are just coincidences.
The curse manifests more dramatically when Shuichi's father dies.
His body is found contorted into a horrific spiral.
The horror of the spiral curse has just begun.

chapters.title: The Twisted Obsession
content: Shuichi's father's death is just the beginning of the spiral madness.
Shuichi's mother also becomes affected by the spiral curse.
She develops an intense fear of spirals and avoids them at all costs.
The fear drives her into madness and self-mutilation.
She cuts away the spiral-shaped parts of her hair and body.
The spiral obsession spreads throughout the town.
Kirie's hair begins to curl into spirals against her will.
The other students in town are also affected.
A student named Katayama becomes obsessed with spiral shapes.
He believes that spirals hold the secret to the universe.
Katayama sculpts spiral figures and worships them.
His obsession leads to his death in a spiral-related accident.
The town's residents are increasingly consumed by the curse.
Kirie realizes that the spiral curse is spreading rapidly.

chapters.title: The Children of the Spiral
content: The spiral curse begins to affect the children of Kurouzu-cho.
They become obsessed with playing in spiral-shaped formations.
The children are drawn to the spiral patterns like moths to a flame.
They gather in large groups and spin around in circles.
The spinning becomes hypnotic and impossible to stop.
The children lose themselves in the spiral madness.
Their bodies contort into horrific spiral shapes.
The parents of the children are powerless to stop it.
The children's bones twist and crack as they spin.
Kirie tries to save a young child from the spiral curse.
The child is already lost to the madness.
Shuichi watches the horror unfold with helpless despair.
The spiral curse is not just an obsession.
It is a physical transformation that destroys the body.

chapters.title: The Snail People
content: A new horror emerges in Kurouzu-cho: the Snail People.
Some residents begin transforming into snail-like creatures.
Their bodies become slimy and soft like snails.
They lose their human features and become mindless creatures.
The Snail People crawl through the streets at night.
They leave trails of slime wherever they go.
The surviving humans are terrified of the transformation.
Kirie witnesses the transformation of a classmate into a snail.
The classmate begs for help but cannot be saved.
The Snail People are drawn to the spiral patterns of the town.
They gather in spiral formations and worship the curse.
The snail-like humans eventually lose all humanity.
They become shells of their former selves.
The curse of the spiral continues to evolve.

chapters.title: The Dragonfly Pond
content: The Dragonfly Pond is the center of the spiral curse in Kurouzu-cho.
The pond is shaped like a perfect spiral.
Kirie and Shuichi discover that the pond is the source of the curse.
Ancient ruins are hidden beneath the pond's surface.
The ruins contain evidence of a civilization that worshipped spirals.
The spiral curse is ancient and predates the town itself.
Kirie learns that the curse has been active for centuries.
The town was built directly on top of the cursed site.
The spiral pattern of the pond draws victims to their doom.
Many people have drowned in the pond over the centuries.
The curse uses the pond to spread through the town.
Shuichi believes that destroying the pond can stop the curse.
The attempt to destroy the pond has tragic consequences.
The curse is stronger and more powerful than they imagined.

chapters.title: The Hospital
content: The spiral curse reaches the local hospital in Kurouzu-cho.
The hospital is filled with victims of the spiral madness.
The patients begin to twist and contort into spiral shapes.
The doctors and nurses are also affected by the curse.
The hospital becomes a house of horror and death.
Kirie and Shuichi try to rescue survivors from the hospital.
They witness the most grotesque transformations yet.
The bodies of patients twist into impossible shapes.
The spiral curse is a living, breathing entity.
It consumes everything it touches.
The hospital is completely destroyed by the curse.
The survivors are left traumatized and broken.
Kirie's fear of the spiral curse intensifies.
She knows that no one is safe from the curse.

chapters.title: The Medusa Hair
content: The spiral curse manifests through the hair of women.
The hair of women in Kurouzu-cho begins to move on its own.
The hair twists and curls into living spirals.
The living hair attacks and strangles the women's families.
The hair becomes a deadly weapon under the curse's control.
Kirie's own hair is attacked by the curse.
She cuts off her hair to escape the horror.
The hair continues to writhe and twist after being cut.
The curse uses the hair as a tool for destruction.
Shuichi's mother is a victim of the hair curse.
Her hair grows uncontrollably and kills her family.
The hair curse is another manifestation of the spiral madness.
Kirie and Shuichi are horrified by the new development.
The curse is relentless and creative in its cruelty.

chapters.title: The Hurricane
content: A massive hurricane approaches Kurouzu-cho.
The hurricane is shaped like a spiral.
The storm is a manifestation of the spiral curse.
The hurricane destroys the entire town.
Kirie and Shuichi survive the hurricane.
They find refuge in a lighthouse on the edge of town.
The survivors of the hurricane gather at the lighthouse.
The spiral curse is still active despite the destruction.
The survivors begin to turn on each other.
The curse drives the remaining humans to madness.
The spiral patterns of the hurricane are everywhere.
The survivors realize they cannot escape the curse.
The hurricane is the final stage of the spiral madness.
Kirie and Shuichi are the last survivors.

chapters.title: The Eternal Spiral
content: The survivors of Kurouzu-cho are trapped in the lighthouse.
The spiral curse has consumed the entire town.
The land itself begins to twist into a spiral shape.
The ground cracks and contorts beneath their feet.
The spiral curse has transformed the geography of the town.
Kirie and Shuichi realize there is no escape.
The curse is eternal and cannot be stopped.
The spiral is the fundamental pattern of the universe.
The world itself is shaped by spirals.
Kirie and Shuichi accept their fate.
They are consumed by the spiral madness.
Their bodies twist into the spiral shape.
The town of Kurouzu-cho disappears into the spiral.
The curse will continue for eternity.

chapters.title: The Endless Night
content: The spiral curse has consumed everything in Kurouzu-cho.
The town no longer exists as it once did.
The survivors are all transformed into spirals.
The spiral is the only thing that remains.
The eternal spiral continues to twist and turn.
There is no escape and no hope.
The curse is absolute and infinite.
Kirie and Shuichi are one with the spiral.
Their suffering has become part of the curse.
The story ends with the image of the endless spiral.
The horror of the spiral is eternal.
The curse will never end.
The spiral is the universe.
The universe is the spiral.
